findings.suggested_fix: Require a root-owned 0750 socket parent instead of 0710 and provision the journal frontend, broker, and collector with membership in socket_gid. Add a Linux permission-boundary test under distinct unprivileged UIDs that exercises the actual directory checks and client initialization.
findings.title: Allow directory reads for the spending frontend and clients
findings.why_it_matters: The new frontend cannot start with its required socket-directory permissions. It runs as the non-root journal UID, requires every ancestor to be root-owned, and opens each directory for reading, but also requires the socket parent to be mode 0710, which grants non-owners no directory-read permission. The broker and collector inherit the same O_RDONLY traversal in PrivateSpendingClient, so even bypassing startup would leave both clients unable to connect. Giving the dedicated group read and traversal permission, with the frontend and clients in that group, makes the checks and transport usable while preserving socket isolation.
findings.validation_reason: In the frozen staged snapshot, harness_spending_runtime.rs:46-48 requires the distinct non-root journal UID, lines 61-70 require empty capabilities, lines 105-115 open the root-owned socket parent O_RDONLY, and line 125 requires mode 0710, which denies that UID directory-read access even with socket-group membership; the configured frontend startup reaches this unconditional check, while existing Python client traversal at protected_spending_control.py:199-202 has the same incompatibility, and runtime incidence was not measured.

findings.title: Exercise optional binding in endpoint discovery tests
findings.why_it_matters: The tests do not protect the change's central compatibility contract: preserving existing services without a binding and adding HarnessSpending only with a binding. The discovery test directly binds HarnessSpending, while both calls to bind_owner assert only success; returning the unmodified builder in the configured case would leave these tests green even though the production owner service disappears. Discovering the builder returned by bind_owner makes the tests sensitive to that failure and to accidental service registration in the absent case.
findings.validation_reason: In the frozen staged snapshot, harness_owner.rs:268 and 345 only check bind_owner success while discovery at lines 308-310 directly binds HarnessSpending, so the new configured-owner path used by private_runtime.rs:622 could return the unchanged builder and all these assertions would remain satisfied; the precondition is a regression in optional binding, whose incidence was not measured, and inspection confirms the tests never discover either returned builder or assert preservation of an existing service.

residual_risks: Before activation, reconcile inherited-listener credentials with client peer authentication: harness_spending_runtime.rs requires an activated fd3, while protected_spending_control.py:276 requires SO_PEERCRED UID == service_uid (journal_uid). A conventional root-created systemd listener reports its creator's credentials even when the socket pathname is chowned to journal_uid; such provisioning would make every broker/collector request fail private_spending_peer_changed. No spending activation unit or producer is installed in this source-only scope, so the eventual listener creator/attestation contract remains unresolved. Existing project research in docs/planning/clean-room/decisions/2026-10-30-root-finalization/security-research.md:11 explicitly identifies this inherited-socket distinction.
The physical capture producer and audit endpoint are expressly not installed in this source-only scope; authenticated closure completeness and durable audit custody remain unverified for live use.
testing_gaps: PrivateCaptureClient.closed and persist_audit are replaced by instance lambdas in test_physical_usage.py:161-162, so the new /capture/ request binding and audit acknowledgement checks (wrong digest, stored=false, malformed acknowledgement) have no behavioral test. Add transport-fake unit cases through these real methods before treating authenticated capture persistence as verified.

normalize_capture's embedding_no_output branch has no test; the only new profile fixture uses inclusive_output_total. Add an embedding profile and capture without output usage, assert zero normalized output and an exact rated receipt, and reject a non-embedding role using that semantics.
